implementation_constraints: reads entire stdin as one JSON document, always exits 0
field type (str vs bool) is fixed at initial-model parse time and never changes across reset/input/toggle
submitted/errors are mutated only by submit and reset events; input/toggle leave them untouched

unresolved_intent.decision: require the input event's value to be a JSON string (else ERROR), even though only field-name/type mismatches are explicitly called out in AC-UI-06
unresolved_intent.rationale: the model only allows string|bool field values, so accepting a non-string value into a string field would silently violate the model's own value-typing rule

unresolved_intent.decision: treat submitted/errors as state mutated ONLY by submit and reset; input/toggle events after a failed submit change fields but leave submitted=false/errors=[prior list] until the next submit or reset
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec says 'later events keep applying after a failed submit' but only submit/reset are defined to touch submitted/errors, so recomputing on every event would be inventing behavior not in the contract

unresolved_intent.decision: only the INITIAL model's field list is checked for duplicates; events can't introduce new fields so no post-init duplicate check is needed
unresolved_intent.rationale: model fields are the only place new names are declared; events strictly reference existing names

unresolved_intent.decision: any structural deviation (missing keys, wrong JSON types, unknown event type, non-dict event/field entries) collapses to the single ERROR output rather than distinguishing error kinds
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec's output contract has no error-detail field — only 'print exactly ERROR' — so finer-grained internal error classification isn't observable and isn't attempted
